articles.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR), America's grocer, today announced its Thanksgiving offerings centered on convenience, flexible feast sizes and effortless meal planning. Designed to meet customer needs across gatherings of any size, Kroger is eliminating holiday kitchen stress with convenient ready-to-eat meal solutions and intuitive, AI-powered planning tools. "At Kroger, we believe Thanksgiving should be about celebrating together," said Mary Ellen Adcock, Executive Vice President and Chief Merchant and Marketing Officer. "We're focused on making holiday meals as simple and seamless as possible for gatherings of any size, ensuring our customers can spend less time cooking and more time enjoying the holiday with the people who matter most." Ready-to-Eat Solutions and "Feast for a Few" Whether rounding out a traditional Thanksgiving spread or building a right-sized dinner for a smaller gathering, Kroger's ready-to-heat assortment delivers classic holiday flavors with little cooking
articles.title: Kroger Makes Thanksgiving Easy This Year with Ultimate Convenience and Seamless Shopping
